SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM SCMTGRDT_KEP WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'STX1' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,PLANT ,LEGACY_PO_NO ,LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,STATUS ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,CURRENCY_CODE ,UNIT_PRICE ,GR_QTY ,GR_AMT ,GR_DATE ,LEGACY_PR_NO ,LEGACY_GR_NO ,LEGACY_GR_SEQ ,DELY_TO_LOCATION ,REMARK ,PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID FROM SCMTGRDT_KEP WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE SCMTGRDT_KEP SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
